entries.title: Paseo v0.16.0-beta.2
entries.note: 0.16.0-beta.2 - 2026-11-11 Background tasks: Paseo now shows the background tasks an agent is running, such as shells and monitors, above the composer, with a Stop button for each. Works with Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode v2. ( #6220 , #9162 by @fxlelouarn ) Plugin sidebar views: A plugin can replace the sidebar's content with its own layout of workspaces, agents, projects and terminals across every connected host. Pick the view per device under Settings → Sidebar; Paseo's sidebar header and footer stay in place. ( #8906 ) Plugin composer controls: Plugins can add their own controls to the composer, and read and set its prompt, attachments, provider, model, mode and thinking. They can also put the cursor in any agent's composer, add items to New workspace, and store their own metadata on agents and workspaces. entries.note: 0.15.1 - 2026-11-05 Fixed Fixed the daemon failing to start when the terminal worker cannot read its own process identity, which left Paseo Desktop without a daemon on Windows machines where Windows PowerShell 5.1 cannot run Get-CimInstance ( #8810 )

entries.title: Paseo v0.15.0
entries.note: 0.15.0 - 2026-11-03 Daemon restarts now keep terminal programs running. Interrupted agents can resume in their existing conversations when you turn on agent recovery. Mobile terminals have native rendering and draggable text-selection handles. Reconnecting restores up to 10,000 lines of terminal history. Worktree setup can copy ignored files and use plugin-defined locations before agents start. entries.title: Paseo v0.14.0
entries.note: 0.14.0 - 2026-10-29 Plugins can now add tools to individual agents and configure their MCP servers when sessions open. Completed conversation turns can be collapsed into summaries and expanded to read the full exchange. Voice settings now let you configure speech providers and download local models with one tap, including SenseVoice and Whisper for Chinese dictation. Voice mode is now opt-in. Added Let plugins give tools to specific agents ( #7938 ) Added Chat display settings that group tool calls or collapse completed conversation turns ( #7785 , #7990 , #8026 , #8042 , #8109 by @akaready , @Dey11 , @Sebeb , @Waishnav ) Let plugins add MCP servers whenever an agent session opens ( #7983 ) Added downloadable local speech models in Voice settings, including SenseVoice and Whisper for Chinese dictation ( #7295 ) Added a choice of Enter or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to send messages ( #5503 by @lukelabo
